A SURREAL LIVING‑TEE CAMPAIGN

THE LIVING TEE

Prompts

by Deniz Akkabak

@deniz.akkabak

NANO BANANA PRO · KLING 3.0 · 6 SCENES

HOW IT WORKS

First teach your face, then build the scene.

reference_1 — your identity reference. Every scene starts from this reference; face, expression, skin tone, hair and especially the glasses are preserved exactly. This is only an example, you will use your own photo.

01 Nano Banana Pro · image

Add your own reference photo, paste the scene’s JSON prompt and generate the image. For the suitcase scene, also add the t-shirt photo as reference_2.

02 Kling 3.0 · video

No personal reference needed here. Feed the image you just generated as the reference, enter the scene’s Kling prompt and turn it into video.

NOTE Keep identity and glasses preservation on in every prompt. The result should read as a real phone photograph, not CGI: natural light, light grain, physical accuracy.
